minutes.headline: Cable committee voted unanimously to invest part of its reserve in laddered six-month Treasuries via the town treasurer.
minutes.summary: The Public Access Cable Committee approved prior minutes with corrections, discussed the water district's camera and recording rules and fair use of film clips, and heard the manager's report and finances. The main action was a motion to invest reserve funds in monthly laddered six-month Treasuries through the treasurer's office. Nomination of officers was left for the July meeting and the next meeting was set for June 12th.

budget_items.what_was_said: Balance reported with only salaries, equipment maintenance, supplies and videographer payroll as April expenses.
Mass Access data showed few subscriber losses and essentially level revenue; a state budget item to support public access was mentioned with a small per-town share.
A member proposed laddering six-month Treasuries monthly with a broker fee and expected interest; noted bank insurance limit.
Motion worded to invest reserve funds in monthly laddered six-month Treasuries through the treasurer's office.

decisions.decision: Nomination of officers was deferred to the first meeting of July, after member appointments are known.
The committee would write its own statement of position on camera and recording rules, supported by the town attorney's advice, rather than reply point by point to the water district.
The fair use guidance will be filed in the committee's files and given to producers and videographers, with a credits line citing fair use.
Staff personal equipment policy to be reviewed with the town attorney, expected on May 22nd.
Next meeting set for June 12th at 6 pm, with July 10th to be booked.

what_happened.line: The committee voted unanimously to invest part of its reserve in monthly laddered six-month Treasuries through the town Treasurer's Office.
The committee decided to write its own statement of position on camera and recording rules, supported by the town attorney, rather than answer the water district point by point.
Nomination of officers was put off to the first July meeting, after member appointments are known.
A motion to look into YouTube monetization for the channel was made, but the minutes record the outcome as not audible.
The next meeting was set for June 12th at 6 pm, with July 10th to be booked.

why_it_matters: The committee's reserve comes from cable revenue, so moving it from bank balances into Treasuries changes how that public money is held and what it earns, and it touches the Treasurer's Office.
Whether the channel can take ad revenue is still open, and the committee's stance on recording rules could affect what the public can film and watch at local meetings.
watch_next: Staff personal equipment policy review with the town attorney, expected May 22nd.
Next meeting June 12th at 6 pm, then the first July meeting for the nomination of officers.
